如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    新书！老朋友们多多支持，许紫烟心中微微一叹，当初来到中都城的时候，以为凭着自己的本事，养活自己的父母应该没有问题，没有想到来到这里之后才发现在自己眼里是很大一笔钱的五两银子根本就什么也买不起，根本没有炼丹和制符的本钱。所以许紫烟现在也很无奈，她心里知道自己需要许家这份客卿长老的工作，如果没有这份工作，恐怕以后的生活都难以为继，这就是穷人的悲哀啊！
想到这里，许紫烟将目光转向了林平海，正好迎上了林平海不屑和嘲讽之极的目光。许紫烟心中一沉，在前世，她是考古界的巅峰人物，是一个十分骄傲的人，这种骄傲长年累月已经渗到了她的灵魂里。就算自己的未来充满了困难，她也不愿意放下自己的骄傲。如果此时自己转身走了，那岂不是等于承认了自己是林平海口中的骗子。但是如果自己在这种情况之下显露自己的制符本领，便也落了下乘，如同急着要向许家自荐一般。
可是如今屋子里的气氛很是诡异，许浩然不言不语，目光之中带着期待，许浩博则是一脸无奈。许紫烟知道这两个人是不会说话了，心道，这件事看来只有自己来解决了。既然你林平海如此嚣张，那就看看谁更嚣张了。
想清楚了一切的许紫烟转过身，目光聚焦在林平海的脸上，淡淡地看着他，一语不发。目光很静，很沉，很稳，如同一个上位者在俯视自己的下属。许紫烟在前世原本就是巅峰般的人物，身上自然带着一股上位者的气息，如今有意识地释放出来，顷刻就让屋子里的三个人脸色一变。
许浩然的眼中闪过睿智的光芒，心中的念头一闪而过：她是谁？这种气质绝对是在某一领域中长久地占领巅峰地位养成的，她来自哪里？是哪个大家族的子弟？还是哪个宗门的弟子？这种气质绝对不是一个散修能够培养出来的！
林平海刚开始被许紫烟的目光望过来，还以为许紫烟受不了自己的压力，准备向自己求饶，眼中不禁透露出更多的嘲弄，刚想再讥讽对方几句，却从对方眼中看到了上位者审视般的眼神。心中一愣，立刻之间一股怒气便冲上的胸臆，看到自己自从进来过去了这么久，说了这么多，家主却是一句支持自己的话也没有说，心中不禁对家主也怨上几分，便转身朝着许浩然说道：
“请族长责罚这个骗子。”
听了林平海的话，许浩然正感为难，却听到许紫烟清冷的声音响起：
“族长，请问这个人是谁？”
“哦，这位是我们家族符堂的供奉长老，一品制符师林平海。”许浩然见到许紫烟向自己问起，心中便有一种不好的预感，但是还是温和地回答道。
“哦~~”许紫烟拉了一个长音，然后淡淡地说道：“一品制符师？他配吗？”
刚开始听到族长介绍自己是一品制符师，林平海还骄傲地挺直了自己的胸脯，他确实有骄傲的资本。在这个大陆上，除了那些宗门之外，在各个家族之中，一品制符师那就是大师。可是还没有等到他骄傲的姿势摆完，耳中便听到了许紫烟那一声：
“他配吗？”
林平海立刻就有一种要吐血的感觉，一张脸立刻涨得通红，坐在上面的族长许浩然心里也不禁苦笑，心道，看来这许紫烟是准备和林平海杠上了。
“小骗子，你说什么？”林平海跳着脚指着许紫烟喝骂道。
“哦，你没有听清楚？要我再说一遍？”许紫烟一副认真地表情，一字一句地说道：“我刚才说的是：你！配！吗？”
“你……你……你敢再说一遍？”林平海的身体开始发抖。
许紫烟换上了一副同情的表情，语气突然变得温和：“唉~~，没有想到你的耳朵也不好，原来是一个有残疾的人。那好吧，我就再和你说一遍，你！配！吗？”
“轰~~”
林平海的身上轰然爆发出愤怒地气息，炼气期五层的修为瞬间提升至巅峰，身形一动便向着许紫烟扑了过来。在林平海气势爆发的那一瞬间，许紫烟也将自己炼气期第一层的修为提升至巅峰，可是她却悲哀地发现自己的修为和对方差得太远，在对方气势的压迫下，自己的身体竟然不能够动弹分毫。

content_en:
If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to access the author’s copyright complaint fast track New book! Old friends gave a lot of support, Xu Ziyan sighed slightly in his heart. When he first came to Zhongdu City, he thought that with his own ability, he would have no problem supporting his parents. He didn't expect that after coming here, he found that five taels of silver, which he considered a lot of money, could not afford to buy anything at all, and he had no capital to refine alchemy and make talismans. So Xu Ziyan is very helpless now. She knows in her heart that she needs the job of the guest elder of the Xu family. Without this job, I am afraid that her future life will be unsustainable. This is the sorrow of the poor!
Thinking of this, Xu Ziyan turned his gaze to Lin Pinghai, and met Lin Pinghai's disdainful and mocking gaze. Xu Ziyan's heart sank. In her previous life, she was the pinnacle figure in the archaeological world and a very proud person. This pride has seeped into her soul over the years. Even if her future is full of difficulties, she is unwilling to let go of her pride. If he turned around and left at this time, wouldn't it be equivalent to admitting that he was the liar Lin Pinghai said he was. But if he reveals his ability to make talismans under such circumstances, he will also fall behind, as if he is eager to recommend himself to the Xu family.
But now the atmosphere in the room is very strange. Xu Haoran is silent, his eyes are filled with expectation, while Xu Haobo has a look of helplessness. Xu Ziyan knew that these two people could no longer speak, and thought, it seems that this matter can only be solved by himself. Since you, Lin Pinghai, are so arrogant, let's see who is more arrogant.
Xu Ziyan, who had thought everything through, turned around and focused on Lin Pinghai's face, looking at him lightly without saying a word. His gaze was very quiet, very deep, and very steady, like a superior looking down at his subordinates. Xu Ziyan was originally a peak figure in his previous life, and he naturally carried the aura of a superior person. Now he consciously releases it, which instantly changes the expressions of the three people in the room.
Xu Haoran's eyes flashed with wisdom, and a thought flashed through his mind: Who is she? This kind of temperament is definitely developed by occupying the top position in a certain field for a long time. Where does she come from? Which big family are you descended from? Are you still a disciple of which sect? This kind of temperament is definitely not something that a casual cultivator can cultivate!
Lin Pinghai was just looking at Xu Ziyan, thinking that Xu Ziyan couldn't stand the pressure on him and was about to beg for mercy. His eyes couldn't help but reveal more ridicule. He was just about to ridicule the other party a few more words, but saw the scrutinizing look of a superior in the other party's eyes. He was stunned for a moment, and immediately a surge of anger rushed into his chest. Seeing that it had been so long since he came in, and that the head of the family had said so much, but the head of the house did not say a word to support him, he couldn't help but feel a little resentful towards the head of the house, and turned around and said to Xu Haoran:
"Please ask the clan leader to punish this liar."
After listening to Lin Pinghai's words, Xu Haoran was feeling embarrassed, but he heard Xu Ziyan's cold voice:
"Clan leader, who is this person?"
"Oh, this is the enshrined elder of our family's Talisman Hall, the first-grade Talisman Maker Lin Pinghai." Xu Haoran had a bad feeling in his heart when he saw Xu Ziyan asking about it, but he still answered gently.
"Oh~~" Xu Ziyan made a long sound, and then said lightly: "First-grade Talisman Maker? Is he worthy?"
When he first heard the clan leader introduce himself as a first-grade talisman maker, Lin Pinghai straightened his chest proudly. He was indeed proud. On this continent, apart from those sects, among all the families, the first-level Talisman Maker is the master. But before he finished his proud posture, Xu Ziyan's voice was heard in his ears:
"Is he worthy?"
Lin Pinghai immediately felt like vomiting blood, his face immediately turned red, and the patriarch Xu Haoran who was sitting on him felt also in his heart.He couldn't help but smile bitterly and thought to himself, it seems that Xu Ziyan is preparing to have a fight with Lin Pinghai.
"Little liar, what did you say?" Lin Pinghai jumped and pointed at Xu Ziyan and cursed.
"Oh, you didn't hear clearly? Do you want me to say it again?" Xu Ziyan said with a serious expression, word by word: "What I just said is: you! Are you worthy!"
"You...you...dare you say it again?" Lin Pinghai's body began to tremble.
Xu Ziyan put on a sympathetic expression, and her tone suddenly became gentle: "Oh~~, I didn't expect that your ears are not good either. It turns out that you are a disabled person. Well, I will tell you again, are you worthy!"
"Boom~~"
Lin Pinghai's body suddenly erupted with an angry aura, and his fifth-level cultivation in the Qi Refining Period instantly reached its peak, and he rushed towards Xu Ziyan as soon as he moved. At the moment when Lin Pinghai's momentum exploded, Xu Ziyan also raised her first-level cultivation to the peak of her Qi refining period. However, she sadly discovered that her cultivation was too far behind that of her opponent. Under the pressure of the opponent's momentum, her body could not move at all.
